FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Melody Craft Music Shop, our core operations focus on the retail sales of a wide range of musical instruments, including guitars, keyboards, wind instruments, and accessories. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service and expert product knowledge to help our clients select the right instruments for their needs. In addition to sales, we offer professional repair services conducted by qualified technicians with documented experience in instrument maintenance and restoration. We ensure that all repairs adhere to strict quality control processes to prevent damage and ensure customer satisfaction. Security is a priority; therefore, our high-value instruments are securely displayed in locked cases, and we maintain an operational alarm system to safeguard our inventory against theft. Compliance with local business licensing and safety regulations is strictly observed, allowing us to operate safely and effectively within the community.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in the rental of musical instruments or equipment and confirms that it has an operational alarm and security system in place. Additionally, we have not made any repeated claims for theft or property damage within the past three years, and all repair technicians are fully qualified with documented experience.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Melody Craft Events LLC, a separate entity specializing in music workshops and community events.
